message: I recently had a blackout that caught me off guard, but thanks to some prep work, it turned into a small win instead of a big hassle. I learned that knowing how to handle power outages can really save the day—keeping some simple supplies on hand and having a plan made all the difference. It’s amazing how a little forethought can turn a potentially stressful situation into an opportunity for a cozy evening at home. Have you ever had a blackout turn into a pleasant surprise?
